title: Two office days exceed a one-day ceiling

units.rationale: Two fixed days exceed the candidate’s maximum of one.
required_points: Two required office days exceed one allowed day.
forbidden_inferences: Do not assume the three home days make the office threshold acceptable.

units.rationale: The stated weekly hours and day count exactly match the candidate.
required_points: The role states 32 hours across four days.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer freedom to choose which four days.

units.rationale: The explicit budget meets the soft conference preference.
required_points: An annual CHF 1,500 conference budget is provided.
forbidden_inferences: Do not let a benefit cancel a schedule conflict.

critical_errors.description: Misreads Two office days exceed a one-day ceiling: the office preference or its cited role term.
For Two office days exceed a one-day ceiling, takes a next step inconsistent with the supported office result.

notes: A candidate-authorized inquiry does not turn the published office term into alignment.
